name: Umbrella Network
report: The vulnerability lies in the _balance function of the StakingRewards contract, where the contract failed to validate the balance value. The attacker triggered an underflow by manipulating the amount parameter, draining tokens from the pool. The contract did not properly use the SafeMath library or include overflow/underflow checks, resulting in a loss of approximately $700,000.
report_zh: 漏洞存在于StakingRewards合约的_balance函数中，该合约未能验证余额值。攻击者通过操纵amount参数触发下溢，从池中耗尽代币。合约未正确使用SafeMath库或包含溢出/下溢检查，导致约70万美元损失。
